task: Write a weekly status update (80–120 words) to your manager Grace on the Harbour Council migration. Done: 18 of 25 VMs migrated. Next week: the last 7, including 2 SQL servers. Blocker: you're still waiting for a firewall rule from the council's network team. Use Done / Next / Blockers.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一份 Harbour Council 迁移项目的周报（80–120 词）。已完成：25 台虚拟机中迁移了 18 台。下周：剩下的 7 台，包括 2 台 SQL 服务器。阻碍：你还在等市政厅网络团队开一条防火墙规则。按“已完成 / 下一步 / 阻碍”来写。
example:
Hi Grace,
Here's this week's update on the Harbour Council migration.
- Done: 18 of the 25 VMs are migrated and running in Azure. Users haven't reported any issues so far.
- Next: we'll move the last 7 VMs next week, including the 2 SQL servers. I've booked Wednesday night for the SQL cutover.
- Blockers: we're still waiting for one firewall rule from the council's network team. Without it, the SQL servers can't talk to the on-prem reporting server. I've chased them twice. Could you mention it to their IT manager if it's not done by Monday?
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write your written stand-up update (60–80 words) in the team's Teams channel. Yesterday you finished setting up Key Vault for Kauri Foods. Today you'll test the app configuration with it. No blockers, but you'll be out from 1 to 2pm.
zh: 在团队 Teams 频道里写你的书面站会更新（60–80 词）。昨天你完成了 Kauri Foods 的 Key Vault 配置。今天你会测试应用配置和它的对接。没有阻碍，但你下午 1 点到 2 点不在。
example:
Morning team, here's my update.
- Yesterday: finished setting up Key Vault for Kauri Foods. All the secrets are in, and access is locked down to the app's managed identity.
- Today: testing the app configuration against Key Vault in the test environment.
- Blockers: none right now.
Just a heads-up that I'll be out from 1 to 2pm, so ping me before or after that if you need anything.

task: Write a RAG status summary (100–140 words) for the Kauri Foods steering group. Overall: Amber. Scope: Green. Budget: Green, 55% spent. Schedule: Amber, because data migration is one week behind. Say what you're doing to recover.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 指导委员会写一份 RAG（红黄绿）状态摘要（100–140 词）。总体：黄。范围：绿。预算：绿，已花 55%。进度：黄，因为数据迁移落后一周。说明你们正在采取什么措施追回进度。
example:
Kauri Foods payroll upgrade: status summary
Overall: Amber
- Scope: Green. No change since last month.
- Budget: Green. We've spent 55% of the budget and we're about 60% through the work.
- Schedule: Amber. Data migration is one week behind. The extract from the old system took longer than planned because of duplicate employee records.
Recovery plan: Raj is joining the data team for the next two weeks, and we're running the clean-up and the second test load in parallel instead of one after the other. If this works, we'll be back on track by 11 December, and the go-live date of 1 March doesn't change.
We'll confirm at the next steering meeting whether schedule is back to Green.

task: Write an update (80–120 words) to Mark, the client sponsor at Kauri Foods. Go-live for the payroll upgrade is moving from 1 March to 15 March because the software vendor's patch is two weeks late. Give the new date first, then the reason and what happens next.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的客户发起人 Mark 写一份更新（80–120 词）。薪资系统升级的上线日期从 3 月 1 日推迟到 3 月 15 日，因为软件供应商的补丁晚了两周。先说新日期，再说原因和接下来的安排。
example:
Hi Mark,
The go-live for the payroll upgrade is moving from 1 March to 15 March.
The reason is that the software vendor's patch, which we need before we can finish testing, is now two weeks late. They've confirmed it will arrive by 12 February.
What happens next: we'll keep going with everything that doesn't depend on the patch, so we don't lose more time. Once it arrives, we'll run the final round of testing and send you the updated cutover plan by 19 February.
There's no change to the budget. Happy to talk it through on a call if that helps.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write an update (70–110 words) to your manager Grace showing progress against milestones for the Coastal Dental Azure project. Milestone 1, design sign-off: done on 9 October. Milestone 2, build: done on 30 October. Milestone 3, testing: on track for 20 November. Milestone 4, go-live: planned for 4 December.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一份 Coastal Dental Azure 项目的里程碑进度更新（70–110 词）。里程碑 1，设计签字：10 月 9 日完成。里程碑 2，搭建：10 月 30 日完成。里程碑 3，测试：按计划 11 月 20 日完成。里程碑 4，上线：计划 12 月 4 日。
example:
Hi Grace,
Coastal Dental is on track. Here's where we are against the milestones:
- M1 Design sign-off: done on 9 October.
- M2 Build: done on 30 October.
- M3 Testing: on track to finish on 20 November. We've passed 34 of 40 test cases, and the rest are booked in for this week.
- M4 Go-live: still planned for 4 December.
No risks to flag right now. I'll send the go-live plan to the client next Tuesday.
Cheers,
{name}

task: Write a short programme update (120–160 words) for Helen, the CIO at Harbour Council, across three workstreams. Network: Green, the new hub network is live. Identity: Amber, MFA is rolled out to 70% of staff but the depot workers have no work phones. Applications: Green, 12 of 20 apps are moved. Say what you need from Helen.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的首席信息官 Helen 写一份简短的项目群更新（120–160 词），涵盖三个工作流。网络：绿，新的中心网络已上线。身份：黄，MFA 已覆盖 70% 员工，但仓库工人没有工作手机。应用：绿，20 个应用已迁 12 个。说明你需要 Helen 做什么。
example:
Hi Helen,
Here's the programme update for this fortnight. Overall we're in good shape, with one item that needs your input.
- Network: Green. The new hub network went live on Tuesday, and all sites are now connected through it.
- Identity: Amber. MFA is now on for 70% of staff. The gap is the depot workers, who don't have work phones, so they can't use the Authenticator app.
- Applications: Green. 12 of the 20 apps have moved to Azure, and the next four are booked for early December.
What we need from you: a decision on MFA for the depot staff. The two options are hardware tokens, around $40 per person, or allowing personal phones with a small allowance. If we can get a decision by 4 December, Identity will be back to Green before Christmas.
Regards,
{name}

task: Write an end-of-sprint update (60–90 words) in the project's Teams channel. The team finished 9 of 11 stories. Two stories, the backup alerts and the cost report, move to the next sprint. The demo is on Thursday at 10am.
zh: 在项目的 Teams 频道写一份冲刺结束更新（60–90 词）。团队完成了 11 个用户故事中的 9 个。两个故事（备份告警和成本报表）挪到下个冲刺。演示在周四上午 10 点。
example:
Sprint 6 wrap-up: we finished 9 of 11 stories. Nice work, everyone!
Two stories are moving to sprint 7: the backup alerts and the cost report. Both are nearly done, but we ran out of time to test them properly.
The demo is on Thursday at 10am. Please bring anything you'd like to show, and let me know by Wednesday so I can put the agenda together.

task: Write a monthly update (80–120 words) to Janet, the practice manager at Coastal Dental, for their managed service. Patching was done on all 6 servers. There were 2 alerts, both for low disk space, and both are fixed. Backups were 100% successful. You recommend resizing one VM to save about $180 a month.
zh: 给 Coastal Dental 的诊所经理 Janet 写一份托管服务月度更新（80–120 词）。6 台服务器都打了补丁。出现了 2 次告警，都是磁盘空间不足，都已解决。备份 100% 成功。你建议调整一台虚拟机的规格，每月大约能省 180 元。
example:
Hi Janet,
Here's your update for November. Everything is running well.
- Patching: all 6 servers were patched on 14 November with no problems.
- Alerts: we had 2 alerts, both for low disk space on the file server. We cleaned up old log files and added more space, so both are fixed.
- Backups: 100% successful all month.
One recommendation: your reporting VM is much bigger than it needs to be. If we resize it, you'd save about $180 a month with no change for your staff. If you're happy with that, we can do it after hours next week.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write an update (70–110 words) to your manager Grace after your first week on the Harbour Council project. Done: you've had your onboarding, got your access (except Azure DevOps), met the client team and read the current design documents. Next week: you'll start the assessment.
zh: 在 Harbour Council 项目上的第一周结束后，给经理 Grace 写一份更新（70–110 词）。已完成：入职培训、拿到了权限（Azure DevOps 除外）、见了客户团队、读了现有的设计文档。下周：开始做评估。
example:
Hi Grace,
Quick update after my first week on Harbour Council. It's been a good start.
- Done: I've finished onboarding and have all my access except Azure DevOps. I've met the client team, including Aroha and the two infrastructure engineers, and read through the current design documents.
- Next week: I'll start the assessment, beginning with the server inventory.
- Blocker: I still need DevOps access. I've asked their service desk, and it should be sorted by Tuesday.
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write an update (80–120 words) to the Harbour Council IT manager on the five follow-up actions from last month's storage outage. Three are done: alerts on storage capacity, a runbook for the service desk, and a second admin with access. Two are still open: the failover test (planned for 8 December) and the vendor review (waiting on the vendor).
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的 IT 经理写一份更新（80–120 词），说明上个月存储故障的五项后续行动。三项已完成：存储容量告警、服务台的处理手册、增加第二个有权限的管理员。两项还没完成：故障切换测试（计划 12 月 8 日）和供应商复盘（在等供应商）。
example:
Hi Paul,
Here's where we are with the five actions from last month's storage outage. Three are done and two are still open.
Done:
- Alerts now fire when storage capacity goes over 80%.
- The service desk has a runbook for this type of outage.
- A second admin now has access, so we're not relying on one person.
Open:
- Failover test: planned for 8 December, after hours.
- Vendor review: we're still waiting on the vendor for their root cause report. I've chased them and expect it this week.
I'll update you again after the failover test.
Regards,
{name}

task: Write a cost update (80–120 words) to your manager Grace. Harbour Council's Azure spend in October was $14,200 against a budget of $12,500. The main reasons: test VMs left running at weekends and a large log storage bill. Say what you've already done and what you'll do next.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一份成本更新（80–120 词）。Harbour Council 10 月的 Azure 费用是 14,200 元，预算是 12,500 元。主要原因：测试虚拟机周末没关，以及一笔很大的日志存储费用。说明你已经做了什么，接下来要做什么。
example:
Hi Grace,
Harbour Council's Azure spend for October was $14,200, which is $1,700 over the $12,500 budget.
There are two main reasons:
- Test VMs were left running at weekends.
- Log storage was much higher than expected because we were keeping every log for 90 days.
What I've done: I've set up auto-shutdown for all test VMs from 7pm to 7am and at weekends.
What's next: I'll cut log retention to 30 days for non-production by Friday, once the client agrees.
Together, these should bring November back under budget. I'll confirm with the numbers in early December.
Cheers,
{name}

task: Write a mid-week update (70–110 words) to Lisa, the IT manager at Kauri Foods. The Azure Virtual Desktop pilot with 20 users is going well and feedback is positive. There are two issues with printing, which you're fixing. The plan is to roll out to 150 users from 30 November.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 IT 经理 Lisa 写一份周中更新（70–110 词）。20 个用户参加的 Azure 虚拟桌面试点进展顺利，反馈很好。打印方面有两个问题，你们正在修。计划从 11 月 30 日开始推广到 150 个用户。
example:
Hi Lisa,
The AVD pilot is going well. All 20 users are working on it every day, and the feedback has been really positive, especially about logon speed.
We've found two issues, both with printing: the label printers in the warehouse aren't showing up, and some PDFs print in the wrong size. We're working on both and expect fixes by Friday.
If the fixes test well, we'll start the rollout to the other 150 users on 30 November as planned.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Your project manager Tom asks in Teams: "Where are we at with the DR test?" Reply (60–90 words). The test is planned for 22 November. The runbook is ready. You've tested failover in the dev environment. You're waiting for the client to confirm who will tell their staff.
zh: 项目经理 Tom 在 Teams 上问：“灾备测试进展怎么样了？”回复他（60–90 词）。测试计划在 11 月 22 日。操作手册已经准备好。你已经在开发环境测过故障切换。你在等客户确认由谁来通知他们的员工。
example:
Hi Tom, the DR test is on track for 22 November.
- The runbook is ready and Raj has reviewed it.
- We tested failover in the dev environment last Thursday, and it took 35 minutes end to end.
- The only open item is comms. We're waiting for the client to confirm who will tell their staff about the test. I've asked Lisa and expect an answer tomorrow.

task: Write a summary (90–130 words) for the monthly service report to the Harbour Council IT manager. 34 tickets were raised and 31 closed. Average response time was 2 hours. Uptime was 99.95%. Coming up: you need to plan for 8 servers running Windows Server 2016, which goes out of support in January 2027.
zh: 为给 Harbour Council IT 经理的月度服务报告写一段摘要（90–130 词）。共提交 34 个工单，关闭 31 个。平均响应时间 2 小时。可用率 99.95%。接下来：有 8 台服务器运行 Windows Server 2016，2027 年 1 月停止支持，需要做计划。
example:
Hi Paul,
Here's the summary for October. It was a steady month with no major incidents.
- Tickets: 34 raised and 31 closed. The 3 still open are all waiting on third parties.
- Response time: 2 hours on average, inside the 4-hour target.
- Uptime: 99.95% across all services.
Coming up: 8 of your servers still run Windows Server 2016, which goes out of support in January 2027. After that, they won't get security updates. We'd like to start planning the upgrade now so it doesn't become a rush. I'll send you a short options paper by the end of next week.
The full report is attached.
Regards,
{name}

task: Write an update (90–130 words) to Lisa at Kauri Foods at the end of phase 1. Phase 1 (the landing zone and identity) is complete. The managed services team now looks after monitoring and patching. Two items are still open: the cost alerts and a naming issue on three resource groups. Phase 2 starts on 7 December.
zh: 在第一阶段结束时，给 Kauri Foods 的 Lisa 写一份更新（90–130 词）。第一阶段（着陆区和身份）已完成。托管服务团队现在负责监控和打补丁。还有两项未完成：成本告警，以及三个资源组的命名问题。第二阶段 12 月 7 日开始。
example:
Hi Lisa,
Good news: phase 1 is complete. The landing zone and identity setup are both live and signed off.
From today, our managed services team looks after monitoring and patching. Their contact details are in the handover document I sent on Monday.
Two small items are still open:
- Cost alerts: built, but we need your finance team to confirm the budget numbers.
- Naming: three resource groups don't follow the agreed naming standard. We'll rename them during phase 2, as it needs a short outage.
Phase 2 starts on 7 December. I'll send the kick-off invite this week.
Thanks for all your help so far.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write a Friday wrap-up (60–90 words) to your team lead Ben on Teams. This week you finished the Coastal Dental backup policy, fixed two VPN tickets and started the Harbour Council cost review. Next week you'll finish the cost review and help Raj with the AVD rollout.
zh: 周五在 Teams 上给组长 Ben 写一份本周总结（60–90 词）。这周你完成了 Coastal Dental 的备份策略，修好了两个 VPN 工单，开始了 Harbour Council 的成本审查。下周你会完成成本审查，并帮 Raj 做 AVD 推广。
example:
Hi Ben, here's my wrap-up for the week.
Done:
- Finished and applied the Coastal Dental backup policy.
- Fixed two VPN tickets for Kauri Foods.
- Started the Harbour Council cost review. About half done.
Next week:
- Finish the cost review and send it to Grace by Wednesday.
- Help Raj with the AVD rollout from Thursday.
Let me know if you'd like me to change the order. Have a good weekend!

task: Write an update (80–120 words) to the Kauri Foods steering group after go-live. The new payroll system went live on Monday. There were two minor issues: a wrong tax code for 3 staff, and a slow report. Both are fixed. Hypercare support runs until Friday 18 December.
zh: 上线后给 Kauri Foods 指导委员会写一份更新（80–120 词）。新的薪资系统周一上线了。出现了两个小问题：3 名员工的税码错了，以及一个报表很慢。两个问题都已修复。上线后的重点支持期（hypercare）持续到 12 月 18 日（周五）。
example:
Hi all,
The new payroll system went live on Monday, and the first pay run went through on time.
We had two minor issues:
- Three staff had the wrong tax code. Payroll corrected them on Tuesday, and no one was underpaid.
- The monthly leave report was very slow. We added an index to the database, and it now runs in under a minute.
Both are fixed. Hypercare support continues until Friday 18 December, and our team is on hand every day for any questions. After that, support moves to the normal service desk.
Thanks to everyone who helped with testing.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Lisa at Kauri Foods is worried the mailbox migration won't finish in time. Write a reassuring update (70–110 words) with the facts: 320 of 450 mailboxes are moved, the other 130 are booked for this weekend, and there have been no data loss issues. Lead with the status.
zh: Kauri Foods 的 Lisa 担心邮箱迁移来不及完成。写一份让她放心的更新（70–110 词），给出事实：450 个邮箱已迁移 320 个，剩下 130 个安排在这个周末，到目前为止没有任何数据丢失问题。开头先说状态。
example:
Hi Lisa,
The mailbox migration is on track to finish this weekend.
- 320 of the 450 mailboxes are already moved to Exchange Online.
- The remaining 130 are booked for this weekend, starting Saturday at 8pm.
- We've had no data loss so far, and we check every mailbox after it moves.
On Monday morning we'll have two people on site to help anyone who has trouble with Outlook. I'll send you a final update on Sunday evening.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write an update (70–110 words) to your manager Grace on the Harbour Council tender response. You're writing the technical section. 3 of 5 parts are done. You need the pricing from Tom by Wednesday. The response is due on Friday at 4pm.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一份 Harbour Council 投标响应的进度更新（70–110 词）。你负责写技术部分。5 部分已完成 3 部分。你需要 Tom 在周三前提供报价。投标截止时间是周五下午 4 点。
example:
Hi Grace,
The technical section of the Harbour Council tender is on track for Friday's 4pm deadline.
- Done: 3 of 5 parts. Current state, proposed solution and security are written.
- In progress: migration approach and support model. I'll finish both by Wednesday.
- Needed: the pricing from Tom by Wednesday, so I can check the numbers match what we're proposing. I've reminded him today.
Could you review the full draft on Thursday morning? That gives us time to fix anything before we submit.
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write an update (80–120 words) to Paul, the Harbour Council IT manager, on a long-running ticket: staff at the Ōrewa office keep losing their VPN connection. Say what you've tried (new firmware, a different tunnel setting), that a Microsoft case is open, and what happens next.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的 IT 经理 Paul 写一份关于一个长期未解决工单的更新（80–120 词）：Ōrewa 办公室的员工 VPN 连接经常断。说明你们已经试过什么（更新固件、换了一种隧道设置），已经向微软开了支持案例，以及接下来怎么做。
example:
Hi Paul,
An update on the VPN drops at the Ōrewa office: the problem isn't fixed yet, but we've narrowed it down.
What we've tried so far:
- Updated the firewall firmware last Tuesday. The drops became less frequent but didn't stop.
- Changed the tunnel timeout setting. No real difference.
The logs now point to the Azure VPN gateway, so we opened a case with Microsoft on Monday. They're looking at the gateway logs now.
Next steps: we'll have a call with Microsoft on Thursday and I'll update you straight after. In the meantime, staff can use the backup connection if the VPN drops.
Regards,
{name}

task: Write an update (70–110 words) to Paul at Harbour Council on the security hardening work. Their Defender for Cloud secure score went from 42% to 68%. You've fixed 15 recommendations. 6 are left, and they need approval from the app owners.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的 Paul 写一份安全加固工作的更新（70–110 词）。他们在 Defender for Cloud 的安全分数从 42% 提高到了 68%。你们修复了 15 条建议。还剩 6 条，需要应用负责人批准。
example:
Hi Paul,
Good progress on the security work: your Defender for Cloud secure score has gone from 42% to 68%.
We've fixed 15 recommendations, including turning on MFA for all admin accounts and closing public access to two storage accounts.
There are 6 recommendations left. They all change how the apps behave, so we need approval from the app owners before we go ahead. I've put the list in the attached spreadsheet, with the owner next to each one.
Could you help us get those approvals by 4 December?
Regards,
{name}

task: You're the buddy for Aroha, a new team member. Write an update (60–90 words) to your manager Grace on her first two weeks. Her access is all sorted, she has joined 3 client calls, and she has finished the first AZ-104 learning module. Next week she starts on Kauri Foods tickets.
zh: 你是新同事 Aroha 的入职伙伴。给经理 Grace 写一份她头两周情况的更新（60–90 词）。她的权限都已办好，参加了 3 次客户会议，完成了 AZ-104 的第一个学习模块。下周她开始处理 Kauri Foods 的工单。
example:
Hi Grace,
Aroha's first two weeks have gone really well.
- Her access is all sorted, including Azure DevOps.
- She's joined 3 client calls with me and asked some great questions.
- She's finished the first AZ-104 learning module.
Next week she'll start on Kauri Foods tickets. I'll give her the simpler ones first and check in with her every day.
Cheers,
{name}

task: Write a quarterly update (130–160 words) for your company's leadership team on three client projects. Harbour Council migration: 80% done, on budget. Kauri Foods payroll upgrade: live, the client is happy. Coastal Dental: delayed by one month because the client changed their IT manager. Start with a one-line summary.
zh: 给公司管理层写一份季度更新（130–160 词），涵盖三个客户项目。Harbour Council 迁移：完成 80%，没有超预算。Kauri Foods 薪资系统升级：已上线，客户满意。Coastal Dental：因为客户换了 IT 经理，推迟一个月。开头先用一句话总结。
example:
Hi all,
In short: two of our three cloud projects are going well, and one is a month behind for reasons outside our control.
- Harbour Council migration: 80% complete and on budget. The last 40 servers move in February, and we expect to finish on time.
- Kauri Foods payroll upgrade: live since November. The client is happy, and they've asked us to quote for moving their finance system next.
- Coastal Dental: delayed by one month. Their IT manager left in October, and the new one wanted to review the design before we continue. We've agreed a new go-live date of 22 March. The delay doesn't change the budget.
No decisions are needed from you this quarter. I'm happy to go into more detail at the next leadership meeting.
Regards,
{name}

task: It's Saturday 6pm during the Harbour Council cutover weekend. Post an update (60–90 words) in the cutover Teams channel. 4 of 6 steps are done. The database copy took 3 hours instead of 2. You're still on track for the go/no-go call at 8am Monday.
zh: 现在是 Harbour Council 割接周末的周六晚上 6 点。在割接的 Teams 频道里发一条更新（60–90 词）。6 个步骤完成了 4 个。数据库复制花了 3 小时，而不是计划的 2 小时。周一早上 8 点的上线决策会议仍然按计划进行。
example:
Cutover update, Saturday 6pm: we're still on track for the go/no-go call at 8am Monday.
- Done: 4 of 6 steps.
- The database copy took 3 hours instead of 2, but we had time built into the plan, so it's fine.
- Next: app testing starts at 7pm, then DNS changes tomorrow morning.
No other issues so far, and the team is in good spirits. Next update at 10pm.

task: Write an update (110–150 words) to your manager Grace with the results of a proof of concept for Kauri Foods: Azure Virtual Desktop versus Windows 365 for 150 users. AVD costs about $5,400 a month and Windows 365 about $7,100. Users liked both. Recommend AVD and give one reason against it too.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一份 Kauri Foods 概念验证的结果更新（110–150 词）：为 150 个用户比较 Azure 虚拟桌面（AVD）和 Windows 365。AVD 每月大约 5,400 元，Windows 365 大约 7,100 元。用户两个都喜欢。推荐 AVD，同时也给出一个不利于它的理由。
example:
Hi Grace,
The Kauri Foods proof of concept is finished, and I recommend Azure Virtual Desktop.
We tested both options with 10 users for two weeks:
- Cost for 150 users: AVD is about $5,400 a month and Windows 365 about $7,100. That's a saving of around $20,000 a year with AVD.
- User feedback: users liked both and didn't notice much difference in speed.
The main reason against AVD is that it needs more work from us to look after. We'd need to manage the host pools and images, while Windows 365 is mostly handled by Microsoft. I think the saving is worth it, as long as it's included in their managed service.
If you agree, I'll write it up for Lisa at Kauri Foods next week.
Thanks,
{name}
